evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of persistently elevated blood pressure despite treatment.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 51 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 180 ms, QRS 108 ms, QTc
415 ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
60%. Trace mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 133 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 70 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 42 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 107 mg/dL

Amlodipine 10 mg by mouth once daily
Losartan 100 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 75 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
